The Free Arabic Library: from the alphabet to Qur’an mastery

Every resource here is free, or has a free tier you can genuinely finish something with. The path runs Modern Standard and Classical Arabic side by side — script, naḥw, ṣarf, vocabulary, tajwīd, and the classical text ladder — with the reference tables, daily routines and milestones that turn a reading list into a study plan.
